mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_conversation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation WHERE owner_user_id = #{owner} AND create_request_id = #{request}
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation WHERE owner_user_id = #{owner} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (created_at, id) < (#{before}, #{beforeId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation_turn WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversation} AND request_id = #{request}
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversation} AND turn_seq > #{after} ORDER BY turn_seq LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversation} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY turn_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation_source WHERE turn_id = #{turn} ORDER BY document_id, version_id
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation_citation WHERE turn_id = #{turn} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT * FROM kb_conversation_batch WHERE turn_id = #{turn} AND batch_seq = #{sequence}
SELECT DISTINCT conversation_id FROM kb_conversation_turn WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now} LIMIT #{limit}

WITH picked AS (SELECT turn_id FROM kb_conversation_settlement WHERE state = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (claimed_until IS NULL OR claimed_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE kb_conversation_settlement s SET claimed_until = #{until}, attempts = s.attempts + 1 FROM picked p WHERE s.turn_id = p.turn_id RETURNING s.*
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_conversation (owner_user_id, title, create_request_id, creation_digest, last_turn_seq, active_turn_id, execution_epoch, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{title}, #{createRequestId}, #{creationDigest}, #{lastTurnSeq}, #{activeTurnId}, #{executionEpoch}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deletedAt}) ON CONFLICT (owner_user_id, create_request_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO kb_conversation_turn (id, conversation_id, turn_seq, request_id, binding_digest, question, assistant_text, status, answer_kind, source_sealed, expected_source_count, source_digest, seal_digest, last_batch_seq, saved_codepoints, ticket_hash, execution_ticket_digest, execution_epoch, lease_until, model_dispatch_intent, usage_status, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, scrubbed, created_at, updated_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{turnSeq}, #{requestId}, #{bindingDigest}, #{question}, #{assistantText}, #{status}, #{answerKind}, #{sourceSealed}, #{expectedSourceCount}, #{sourceDigest}, #{sealDigest}, #{lastBatchSeq}, #{savedCodepoints}, #{ticketHash}, #{executionTicketDigest}, #{executionEpoch}, #{leaseUntil}, #{modelDispatchIntent}, #{usageStatus}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{scrubbed}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_conversation_turn SET conversation_id = #{conversationId}, turn_seq = #{turnSeq}, request_id = #{requestId}, binding_digest = #{bindingDigest}, question = #{question}, assistant_text = #{assistantText}, status = #{status}, answer_kind = #{answerKind}, source_sealed = #{sourceSealed}, expected_source_count = #{expectedSourceCount}, source_digest = #{sourceDigest}, seal_digest = #{sealDigest}, last_batch_seq = #{lastBatchSeq}, saved_codepoints = #{savedCodepoints}, ticket_hash = #{ticketHash}, execution_ticket_digest = #{executionTicketDigest}, execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, model_dispatch_intent = #{modelDispatchIntent}, usage_status = #{usageStatus}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, scrubbed = #{scrubbed}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_conversation_source (turn_id, document_id, version_id) VALUES (#{turnId}, #{documentId}, #{versionId})

INSERT INTO kb_conversation_citation (turn_id, ordinal, document_id, version_id, chunk_id, title, version_no, page_no, heading_path, structure_type, source_locator, source_line_start, source_line_end, source_char_start, source_char_end, context_truncated) VALUES (#{turnId}, #{ordinal}, #{documentId}, #{versionId}, #{chunkId}, #{title}, #{versionNo}, #{pageNo}, #{headingPath}, #{structureType}, #{sourceLocator}, #{sourceLineStart}, #{sourceLineEnd}, #{sourceCharStart}, #{sourceCharEnd}, #{contextTruncated})
INSERT INTO kb_conversation_batch (turn_id, batch_seq, digest, codepoints) VALUES (#{turnId}, #{batchSeq}, #{digest}, #{codepoints})

INSERT INTO kb_conversation_settlement (turn_id, user_id, department_id, lease_id, event_id, reserved_tokens, usage_status, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, charged_tokens, generation_status, intent_digest, state, attempts, claimed_until, next_attempt_at, created_at, finalized_at, settled_at) VALUES (#{turnId}, #{userId}, #{departmentId}, #{leaseId}, #{eventId}, #{reservedTokens}, #{usageStatus}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{chargedTokens}, #{generationStatus}, #{intentDigest}, #{state}, #{attempts}, #{claimedUntil}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt}, #{finalizedAt}, #{settledAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_conversation_settlement SET user_id = #{userId}, department_id = #{departmentId}, lease_id = #{leaseId}, event_id = #{eventId}, reserved_tokens = #{reservedTokens}, usage_status = #{usageStatus}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, charged_tokens = #{chargedTokens}, generation_status = #{generationStatus}, intent_digest = #{intentDigest}, state = #{state}, attempts = #{attempts}, claimed_until = #{claimedUntil}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, created_at = #{createdAt}, finalized_at = #{finalizedAt}, settled_at = #{settledAt} WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} AND state NOT IN ('SETTLED','REVIEW')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_conversation_citation WHERE turn_id IN (SELECT id FROM kb_conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversation})
DELETE FROM kb_conversation_source WHERE turn_id IN (SELECT id FROM kb_conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversation})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_conversation_turn SET question = NULL, assistant_text = NULL, saved_codepoints = 0, scrubbed = true WHERE conversation_id = #{conversation}
UPDATE kb_conversation_settlement SET state = 'SETTLED', settled_at = #{now}, claimed_until = NULL WHERE turn_id = #{turn} AND intent_digest = #{digest} AND state = 'PENDING'
